This plot is very small, just a corner of my land where I grow something other than my main crops. Since it is so small and not one of the cereals I sell, I do not buy chemical fertilizer for it — I save the fertilizer money for my bigger fields. I put household manure on it when I have some, and I use seed I saved myself. My daughter and I can manage the work ourselves, so I do not hire anyone for such a small piece.
